records.addendum: This is an updated version from your doctor. Reason: {{reason}}
records.noMedicines: No medicines – follow the advice below.
records.shareHint: Sharing sends the PDF itself (for example to a pharmacy or family member). Share only with people you trust.
records.shareFallback: Sharing isn't available on this device – the PDF opened in a new tab so you can save or print it.

err.rx_not_allowed: A prescription can be written only once the consultation has started.
err.signature_invalid: Use a PNG image between 100×30 and 1600×800 pixels, up to 200 KB.
err.drug_blocked: A medicine on the list isn't allowed in this consultation.
err.use_catalogue_entry: This medicine is already in the medicine list. Please choose it from the list so the prescribing rules apply.
err.custom_disabled: Adding medicines that are not in the list is switched off at your hospital.
err.custom_invalid: The medicine details are not valid. Check the name (2 to 80 characters).
err.custom_not_acknowledged: Confirm that you have checked each manually added medicine before signing.
err.too_many_custom: A prescription can have at most 10 medicines that are not in the list.
err.use_addendum: This prescription is already signed – add an addendum to change it.
err.signature_missing: Upload your signature before signing prescriptions.
err.notes_missing: Write the clinical notes (with a diagnosis) first.
err.diagnosis_required: Add at least one diagnosis before signing.
err.rx_empty: Add a medicine, advice or investigations before signing.
err.reason_required: Give a reason for the addendum (at least 5 characters).
err.not_latest: Only the latest version can be amended.
err.pin_locked: Signing is locked for 15 minutes after too many wrong PINs.
err.invalid_diagnosis: That diagnosis isn't a valid ICD-10 code.
err.notes_final: The notes are final and can't be changed.
err.invalid_input: Something in the form isn't valid.
err.too_many_templates: You can keep up to 50 templates.

verify.title: Prescription verification
verify.subtitle: Sunrise Chain of Hospitals – check that a prescription is genuine and current.
verify.validBody: Issued by a Sunrise doctor and not replaced by a newer version.
verify.supersededBody: This prescription was genuine but the doctor has issued an updated version. Ask the patient for the latest one.
verify.notFoundBody: No Sunrise prescription has this code. Check the code, or contact the hospital.
verify.error: Couldn't check right now. Try again.
verify.rateLimited: Too many checks from this connection. Try again in a few minutes.
verify.enterCode: Verification code (printed under the QR code)
verify.privacy: For privacy, this page never shows the patient's name or the medicines.

prefs.title: Notifications
prefs.subtitle: How we reach you about bookings, payments and prescriptions.
prefs.smsHint: Text messages to your registered mobile number.
prefs.remindersHint: 24 hours, 1 hour and 10 minutes before, and follow-up reminders. They always appear here in the app.
prefs.pushHint: Alerts on this phone or computer, even when the app is closed.
prefs.pushUnsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
prefs.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings.
prefs.privacy: Messages never contain medical details – only a secure link that opens after you sign in. WhatsApp messages are sent only if you have given WhatsApp consent.

link.title: This link can’t be opened
link.body: It may have expired, or it was sent to a different account. Sign in with the mobile number the message was sent to.

feedback.title: Rate your consultation
feedback.question: How was your consultation with {{doctor}}?
feedback.commentHint: Please don’t include medical details. Your comment is shared with Sunrise, not published.
feedback.notAvailable: Feedback opens once the consultation is completed.

admin.subtitle: Every WhatsApp, SMS, push and in-app message, with delivery status and cost.
admin.privacy: Numbers are masked. Messages carry no clinical details, and the link opens only in the recipient’s own account.
admin.templatesHint: Placeholders are limited to name, doctor, date, time, reference, amount and a secure link, so no clinical details can be sent.
admin.quietLong: Hold during quiet hours (9 pm – 8 am IST)
admin.approvalHint: WhatsApp and DLT wording must match what Meta and the DLT portal approved. Change the template name or id when you change the text.
admin.ratesHint: Used for the cost counters. SMS is charged per 160-character part (70 for Malayalam).

dash.subtitle: Today at a glance, what needs a person, and recent trends. All times IST.

c.revenueHint: Payments captured minus refunds paid out that day.

doc.subtitle: Onboarding, registration checks and suspension. A second admin always verifies.
doc.newHint: Profile first; then the login and the registration certificate.
doc.readOnly: Only admins and coordinators can edit doctors.
doc.phoneHint: The doctor signs in with an OTP on this number.
doc.phoneLocked: This is the doctor's login; it can't be changed here.
doc.regLocked: Locked while verified or under verification.
doc.loginOk: The doctor signs in with an OTP on {{phone}}.
doc.loginHint: Creates a login for {{phone}}. The doctor signs in with an OTP; no password is sent.
doc.uploadHint: PDF, JPG or PNG up to 10 MB.
doc.file_type: Only PDF, JPG or PNG files.
doc.file_too_large: The file is larger than 10 MB.
doc.twoPerson: Two-person rule: the admin who verifies can be neither the person who created nor the person who submitted the doctor.
doc.notYou: You created or submitted this doctor, so another admin must verify.
doc.adminVerifies: An admin will check the registration.
doc.verifyNotePh: e.g. Checked the number on the TCMC online register on 27 Oct; name and qualification match.
doc.noteHint: At least 10 characters. Stored with your name in the audit log.
doc.suspendBody: No new bookings. Every future booking is cancelled and each patient is offered a free reschedule or a full refund.
doc.reinstateBody: The doctor goes back to "waiting for verification"; another admin must check the registration again.

mast.subtitle: Hospitals, departments, holidays, the drug formulary and ICD-10 codes.
mast.deactivateHint: A hospital or department with doctors can't be deactivated.
mast.holidayHint: No new bookings can be made that day. Existing bookings stay – move them from the appointment monitor.
mast.holidayBookings_one: Holiday added. {{count}} existing booking that day needs moving.
mast.holidayBookings_other: Holiday added. {{count}} existing bookings that day need moving.
mast.drugHint: The list (O / A / B / Prohibited) decides when a doctor may prescribe it by teleconsultation.
mast.scheduleX: Schedule X drugs must be on the Prohibited list.

appt.subtitle: Every booking, live. Manual actions need a reason and are audited.
appt.onlyAttention: Only bookings that need a person

outHint.patient_no_show: Refund per the patient no-show policy.
outHint.doctor_no_show: The patient chooses a free reschedule or a full refund.
outHint.technical_failure: The patient chooses a free reschedule or a full refund.

appt.privacy: Clinical details are not shown here.
appt.noActions: No manual actions for this booking.
appt.cancelBody: The patient and the doctor are told; the slot opens again.

refund.policy: As per the patient cancellation policy

appt.fullOnly: Coordinators can only cancel with a full refund.
appt.moveBody: Same reference; the patient (and the doctors) are told. Documents and payment move with it.
appt.noSlots: No free times in the next 7 days.
appt.feeKept: The fee already booked is kept – a move never costs the patient more.
appt.outcomeBody: For bookings the automatic rules did not settle. Confirm with the doctor or patient first.
appt.extendBody: Up to 60 minutes in total ({{used}} used).

cont.subtitle: Consent wording and legal pages, in English and Malayalam, versioned.
cont.required: Required consent – patients must accept the current version.
cont.document: Public page, linked from the consent screen.
cont.fixHint: Keeps version {{version}}; nobody is asked again.
cont.newVersionHint: A material change: every patient accepts it again on their next visit before booking.
cont.newVersionDocHint: A material change, shown with the new version number and date.
cont.publishReconsent: All patients will be asked to accept this again before their next booking.
cont.publishedReconsent_one: Published v{{version}} – {{count}} patient will be asked again
cont.publishedReconsent_other: Published v{{version}} – {{count}} patients will be asked again

users.subtitle: Staff roles (admin, coordinator, finance). Every change needs a reason and is audited.
users.adminOnly: Only admins manage users and roles.
users.revoke: With no roles this person can no longer use the console.

roleHint.admin: Everything, including roles, masters, verification and content.
roleHint.coordinator: Bookings, doctor onboarding, support tickets. No money decisions.
roleHint.finance: Payments, refunds, fees and revenue reports. No clinical data.

users.inviteHint: They receive a link to set a password, then sign in with email and password.
users.name: Full name
users.linkHint: No email is sent on this server. Give this one-time link to the person privately.
users.rules: Doctors are managed under Doctors. Patients can't be given staff roles. Nobody can change their own roles, and there is always at least one admin.

tkt.subtitle: Questions and complaints from patients and doctors. Internal notes stay with Sunrise.
tkt.noAccess: Support is handled by admins and coordinators.
tkt.noteLabel: Internal note (not shown to the user)
tkt.replyHint: The user is notified with a secure link; the message itself is only in the app.

audit.subtitle: Who changed what, when and why. Append-only; clinical free text is redacted.
audit.adminOnly: Only admins can read the audit log.
audit.redacted: Clinical free text appears as [redacted] in the log by design.

rep.subtitle: Choose a report and a period; export to CSV (opens in Excel). No report identifies a patient.
rep.truncated_one: Showing the first 500 of {{count}} row – the CSV has all.
rep.truncated_other: Showing the first 500 of {{count}} rows – the CSV has all.
rep.badRange: The start date must be before the end date.

d.appointments: Every booking with doctor, department, status, outcome and payment.
d.revenue: Per day: payments, gross, refunds and net.
d.no_shows: Per doctor: outcomes of consultations that were due.
d.utilisation: Per doctor: slots offered vs booked.
d.follow_ups: Per doctor: free follow-ups booked, completed and the fee forgone.
d.notifications: Per message and channel: delivery, failures and cost.

note.appointments: Times in IST. Moved bookings appear once, under their new time.
note.revenue: Gross counts payments captured that day; refunds count when paid out. Net = gross − refunds paid out.
note.no_shows: Due = completed + no-shows + technical failures + doctor cancellations. Rates are shares of due.
note.utilisation: Offered = open, held or booked slots (blocked excluded). Utilisation = booked ÷ offered.
note.follow_ups: Fee forgone uses the doctor's current follow-up fee.
note.notifications: Delivery rate excludes skipped messages (no opt-in or switched off).

help.title: Help & support
help.subtitle: Ask Sunrise about a booking, payment or anything else.
help.newHint: A person at Sunrise replies here, usually within one working day.
help.noneBody: Raise one if something is not right.
help.subject: Subject
help.privacy: Please share only what Sunrise needs to help. For medical questions, book a consultation.
help.rateLimited: You have sent several requests – please wait a while.
help.call: For anything urgent about a booking, call +91 484 200 0100.
help.reopen: Still need help? Reply to reopen

setpw.title: Set your password
setpw.expired: This link has expired or was already used. Ask an admin for a new invite.
setpw.rule: At least 12 characters, with letters and numbers.
setpw.done: Password set – sign in with your email
setpw.failed: Couldn't set the password. Try a stronger one.

pwa.offline: You're offline. Bookings, consultations and records need a connection.
pwa.update: A new version of Sunrise Care is ready.
pwa.installBody: Add Sunrise Care to your home screen for quicker access. Your health records stay on Sunrise servers, not on the phone.
pwa.iosHint: In Safari, tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".

abha.title: ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account)
abha.subtitle: Link this profile to an ABHA so your Sunrise records can be shared with your consent.
abha.optional: Optional – you can book and consult without an ABHA.

err.abdm_disabled: ABHA linking is not available yet.
err.not_configured: ABHA linking is not available yet.
err.invalid_abha: That doesn't look like a valid ABHA number or address.
err.invalid_input: Please check the details and try again.
err.invalid_otp: The OTP didn't match. Please try again.
err.txn_expired: The OTP has expired. Please request a new one.
err.abha_in_use: This ABHA is already linked to another profile.
err.abdm_no_account: No ABHA was found for these details.

sys.title: System status
sys.subtitle: Which services are simulated and which are real. Only modes are shown, never keys or values.

hint.mock: Simulated: nothing real is sent or charged
hint.sandbox: Test service: no real money or patients
hint.unconfigured: Missing its settings, so it does not work yet

detail.mock_payments_disabled: Mock gateway is switched off and no real gateway is set up

sys.unverified: Adapter not yet tested against the real system

warn.title: This production environment is not fully live
warn.mock: {{name}} is simulated (mock): nothing real is sent or charged
warn.open_cors: Browser access is open to any website (ALLOWED_ORIGINS is not set)

intg.adminOnly: Only admins can change integration settings.
intg.subtitle: Hospital systems, CRM and ABDM. Events are queued and sent with retries.

desc.his: Patient master, consultation summaries, prescriptions and billing.
desc.leadsquared: Name, mobile, city and journey events – only for patients who opted in. Nothing clinical.
desc.abdm: Optional ABHA verification and linking for patients.

intg.doctorSyncHint: HIS doctor codes are matched by registration number. Verification stays in this console.

err.waiting_for_mrn: Waiting for the HIS patient number
err.no_activity_code: No LeadSquared activity code for this event

intg.privacy: Events store only record references. Payloads are built when sent; LeadSquared never receives clinical details.
intg.abdmWarn: Turning ABDM on shows ABHA linking to patients. Only do this once the ABDM sandbox or production keys are configured.

mfa.enrollBody: Staff accounts need a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or similar). Scan the QR code, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.verifyBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Sunrise Care Connect.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code to add Sunrise Care Connect to your authenticator app
mfa.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app instead:
mfa.wrong: That code didn't work. Check the time on your phone and try the next code.
